description: This file defines an Android activity named LauncherShortcuts that manages the creation and handling of launcher shortcuts within the app. It handles intents for creating shortcuts and displays information about incoming shortcut intents.

classes.name: LauncherShortcuts
classes.description: An Activity that handles creating launcher shortcuts and displaying info when a shortcut is triggered.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, handles shortcut creation intent or displays incoming intent info.

methods.name: setupShortcut
methods.description: Creates a launcher shortcut intent with icon, name, and target activity, and returns it as the activity result.
